notes: Flagged unit 30 (s029-s031, מִלְּפָנָיו → 'before') retained: מִן, לְ and the construct פָּנֶה are contiguous and one English word carries the pair's whole relation, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and rule 23 heads it on the construct noun. Splitting it would leave two morphemes holding nothing while a third held the whole word, which rules 22 and 30 forbid.
s017 with s020 → 'Nor' is rule 35's waw-plus-negative fusion across the fronted 'from it'; distance does not break it, and the head stays on the negative.

t019 'anything' is added on rule 17's ground that a lexical English subject supplied where no source nominal stands answers to no morpheme; the coordination and negation are already spent in 'nor'. The competing reading giving it to the existential is named in the unit note.
t027 'it' and t029 'men' are added under rules 44 and 17 respectively: no object morpheme and no subject nominal stands in either clause.
